# Paste Prompts

> A marketplace where people discover, buy and instantly use high-performing AI prompts for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney and more — copy and paste in seconds.

Paste Prompts is a curated marketplace of vetted, parameterised AI prompts. Buyers find prompts that actually work and use them instantly; creators upload prompts and earn from every sale. Individual prompts are priced at £0.25.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the marketplace and trending prompts.
- [Browse prompts](/browse): Search and filter prompts by price, AI platform and category.
- [Free prompts](/browse?price=free): Ready-to-use prompts you can copy for free.
- [Membership plans](/pro): Free, Pro and Platinum creator membership tiers and pricing.

## Prompts by AI tool

- [ChatGPT prompts](/prompts/chatgpt-prompts): Tested ChatGPT prompts for writing, marketing and productivity.
- [Claude prompts](/prompts/claude-prompts): Prompts tuned to Claude for long-form writing and analysis.
- [Gemini prompts](/prompts/gemini-prompts): Google Gemini prompts for research and productivity.
- [Midjourney prompts](/prompts/midjourney-prompts): Image prompts with parameters baked in.
- [Free AI prompts](/prompts/free-ai-prompts): Hundreds of free prompts, no sign-up to browse.


## Categories

- [Make Money Online](/category/make-money-online): Prompts for online income and side hustles.
- [Business & Marketing](/category/business-marketing): Prompts for marketing, sales and operations.
- [Copywriting](/category/copywriting): Prompts for high-converting copy.
- [AI Tools](/category/ai-tools): Prompts to get more from AI tools.
